title: Re-point a meaning's analysis
description: Points a meaning, top level or nested, at a different analysis of the same entry, keeping all its content; Motif stages a Draft for a person to review and Apply. If no sense would use the old analysis afterwards, LibLCM removes it, and the operation's rationale says so. It refuses an analysis of another entry, a stem analysis on an affix, an affix analysis on a stem, a meaning that already uses the analysis, and an old analysis something else still refers to.
